what: NDT-BF16 (2026-10-17): the bf16 GEMM contract -- operands rounded to bfloat16, accumulated in binary32 as the AMX unit's TDPBF16PS accumulates them -- pinned against the instruction first (BF16-0), then built as a contract with portable, AVX-512 and AMX instances over operands packed into workspace the caller lends (BF16-1), and put under the native trainer's GEMMs as BCIR_DT_CONTRACT_BF16 (BF16-2: state ABI 4, Python bf16, bf16+exp and each +reduce). Only the GEMMs change: the attention, the norms, the activations, the gradients, the moments and the update stay binary32.
host: 4-vCPU Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz container (family 6 model 207: AVX-512 with AVX512-BF16/FP16, AMX-TILE/AMX-BF16/AMX-INT8; 48 KB L1d and 2 MB L2 a core, a 260 MB L3) -- the instance of ../pack/ and ../paired/ -- GCC 13.3, Clang 18.1 and Clang 23.1 (check.txt), Python 3.11.15 (the declared floor); every .txt names the head and the digest of runtime/c against it (17cff8d and this commit's runtime/c); indicative wall times, no PMU

files.run.sh: the records in order (bash run.sh TMP CLANG23 DATA [STAGE...] from the repository root)
files.semantics.c, semantics.txt: BF16-0: TDPBF16PS against twelve candidate models on four operand distributions (51,200 outputs each) and at every depth of one to sixteen pair rows (13,056 outputs each), under MXCSR RZ+FTZ+DAZ, and on crafted edges (signed zeros, subnormal operands and accumulators, the underflow boundary, overflow, NaN payloads); VDPBF16PS against four models; VCVTNEPS2BF16 against nearest-even with and without DAZ/FTZ over all 2^32 inputs
files.tininess.c, tininess.txt: the lane's flush at the underflow boundary: 1,024,000 lanes built at it, each computed by the tile unit, by one vfmadd per lane step under MXCSR FTZ|DAZ, by the contract's rule (tiny after rounding with the exponent unbounded) and by flushing after rounding to the subnormal grid
files.cvt2.c, cvt2.txt: VCVTNE2PS2BF16, the AMX host's pack conversion, against the contract's conversion on every binary32 in both source positions, and under MXCSR RZ+FTZ+DAZ
files.check.c, check.txt: every instance, entry (variant, pool, group), chunked workspace, refusal and crafted edge against an independent reference (binary32 operands read directly, lanes in __float128, tininess by an explicit 24-bit rounding): GCC 13, Clang 18 and Clang 23 builds (the widest instance AMX), one capped below AMX (BCIR_TENSOR_MAX_VARIANT=4) and the portable build
files.cols_check.c, cols_check.txt: the region width (bf16_cols) as it first shipped against the one counted in whole 32-column blocks after clang's analyzer found the empty shapes dividing by zero: equal on every non-empty shape of the grid, a positive multiple of 32 on every empty one
files.gemm.c, gemm-t4.txt, gemm-t1.txt, gemm-v: the 9.84M decoder's 13 GEMM shapes, the bf16 pooled entry (the widest admitted instance) against the blocked FP32 kernel at four and one threads, the call pairs alternated, medians of 15 and 9; gemm-v4 the AVX-512 instance alone on the calling thread (timed before the empty-shape fix, on runtime/c 9aac2c58 against 17cff8d as the headers say; the fix partitions no non-empty call differently: cols_check.txt)
files.step.py, step-t4.txt, step-t1.txt: the 9.84M decoder's training step (batch 8 x 128 tokens) under kblock+exp+reduce and bf16+exp+reduce, the contracts alternated round by round, every step timed alone (timed before the empty-shape fix, on runtime/c 9aac2c58 against 17cff8d as the headers say; the fix partitions no non-empty call differently: cols_check.txt)
files.attribution-t4-{bf16,kblock}-{1,2,3}.jso: the step in place at four threads, statement by statement (docs/research/measurements/2026-10-13/scan/attribution.py --src runtime/c --data DATA --threads 4 --steps 8 --contract bf16+exp+reduce | kblock+exp+reduce), three rounds each, the two alternated (timed before the empty-shape fix, on runtime/c 9aac2c58 against 17cff8d as the headers say; the fix partitions no non-empty call differently: cols_check.txt)
files.identity.json: the comparison harness's identity stage (train_comparison.py identity --steps 6 --threads 1,4 --contract bf16+exp+reduce --variants widest,avx512,avx2,portable): six steps of the comparison decoder through the tile instance (widest), the AVX-512 instance (the unit capped at AVX-512) and the portable one (capped at AVX2, and built portable), at one and four threads, and the first build again
files.lm/: LM-BF16 (the report's section 32): the 1,000-step language model under the contract against PyTorch's CPU mixed precision and both FP32 arms, five seeds paired (its own README.json)

faults: tools/testing/faults/ndt-bf16.json, NB1-NB17, each injected and observed to fire (python3 tools/testing/red_sweep.py --faults tools/testing/faults/ndt-bf16.json)
reading: TDPBF16PS: model [5] -- per instruction two lanes from +0.0, the even terms' fused products in one and the odd terms' in the other, each step rounded once and flushed when tiny, then c = daz(c) + (E + O), the sum flushed -- matches 51,200 of 51,200 outputs on every distribution and 13,056 of 13,056 at every depth; no other model matches all of any distribution; 0 of 13,056 outputs move under MXCSR RZ+FTZ+DAZ. Tininess: the contract's rule and the vfmadd replay equal the tile unit on all 1,024,000 boundary lanes, flushing after rounding to the grid is wrong on 511,998. VDPBF16PS: the odd term first, one chain from the accumulator, 51,200 of 51,200 on every distribution (even first 45,175-49,322) -- not an instance of the tile unit's contract. VCVTNEPS2BF16: nearest-even after DAZ on every one of the 2^32 inputs (without DAZ 16,711,678 subnormals differ), MXCSR ignored; VCVTNE2PS2BF16 the same function on every input. The independent reference: 0 of 963 cases differ under GCC 13, Clang 18 and Clang 23 (instances 1, 4, 8), 0 of 718 capped below AMX, 0 of 473 portable. GEMM shapes at four threads: 16.536 -> 4.359 ms (x3.79; 943-1,839 GFLOP/s against 320-453); at one thread 50.324 -> 10.429 ms (x4.83); the AVX-512 instance alone at 0.56 of the FP32 kernel (50-73 GFLOP/s against 92-143: a broadcast, a shift and a mask beside each pair's two FMAs), so without AMX the contract buys no speed. The step at four threads 188.1 -> 79.8 ms (5,445 -> 12,832 tokens a second, x2.36), at one thread 623.7 -> 256.2 ms (x2.43), with 11,534,592 bytes of workspace; in place the GEMMs 150.8 -> 41.8 ms a step at four threads (medians of three rounds), the attention 14.6 / 15.4, the update 9.3 / 9.5 -- the GEMMs half the bf16 step, the attention a fifth. Identity: one state, e91ae701..., on every row (avx2 at 1 thread 83,846 ms, avx2 at 4 threads 23,355 ms, avx512 at 1 thread 1,283 ms, avx512 at 4 threads 333 ms, portable at 1 thread 80,015 ms, portable at 4 threads 20,930 ms, widest at 1 thread 370 ms, widest at 4 threads 87 ms; a median step each, run on the committed code after the empty-shape fix); the portable instance is the reference, not a speed path.
